description: Belagsarten Straßen Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by digitales.wien.gv.at. Presentation of the types of coverings from the streets of Vienna Important note: Due to the enormous amount of data from the road information system, it is strongly recommended that the vector download via WFS (or also at KML) retrieves SLEINE sections (e.g. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Rubber types Streets Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Straßenoberfläche, Straßenfläche, Beläge, ViennaGIS, Belagsart, Straße. The listing shows 6 download or service links in HTML, PNG, SHP, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
